name: Agent Forensic Audit
tagline: A paid reconstruction of what the agent actually did.
summary: Deep-dive on one deployed agent: audit-trail reconstruction, failure-mode analysis, quality review, and remediation list. The wedge product. Converts into recurring audit/compliance follow-on work.
description: Agent Forensic Audit is a manual engagement against one deployed agent. The work is reconstruction, not a dashboard login: review the signed audit evidence, trace what happened, name failure modes, pull quality-scoring outputs where data exists, and leave the buyer with a remediation list they can act on. It is priced to get a yes and scoped to convert the next conversation into recurring audit or compliance coverage.
buyer: Anyone with a deployed agent they no longer fully trust — after an incident, before a board review, or as a condition of putting the agent in front of customers.

features.name: Audit trail reconstruction
features.detail: Rebuild the event timeline from the signed, tamper-evident audit records and surrounding context.

features.name: Failure-mode analysis
features.detail: Name the ways this agent actually failed or nearly failed in the observed deployment.

features.name: Quality review
features.detail: Use existing quality scores and supporting evidence where that telemetry exists; this is not yet an automated drift-watch product.

features.name: Remediation list
features.detail: Ordered fixes, process changes, and the recurring SKU that would have reduced the incident surface.

source_components.maps_to: Signed audit evidence, attribution, compliance tags, and stored events for reconstruction.
Existing quality score outputs where relevant data is available.

readiness.next_action: This week's play. Sell the engagement, then convert the findings into OBS-02 or AUD-02 follow-on work.
